arena: [생존기] Barkskin can be used while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared or asleep, and reduces damage taken by 20% for 8 sec. Pop it immediately when burst comes in while you're CC'd.
[생존기] Survival Instincts has 2 charges and reduces damage taken by 50% for 6 sec. Use one charge at a time when enemy burst cooldowns are focused on you.
[차단] Skull Bash charges a target within 13 yds, interrupts the cast and locks that school for 5 sec; Charging Bash adds 10 yds range. Save it for the enemy healer's heal casts.
[제어] Overrun charges the target, stuns it for 3 sec and knocks back its allies within 15 yds. Stun the enemy healer while peeling the DPS next to them.
[제어] Incapacitating Roar incapacitates enemies within 10 yds for 3 sec but damage can break it. Use it when enemies your team isn't hitting are grouped up.
[분담] With Den Mother, allies within 15 yds gain 15% max health and stuns on you are 15% shorter. Fight close to your team.
[광역 피해] With Demoralizing Roar, enemies within 10 yds deal 20% less damage for 8 sec. Use it among enemy melee DPS when they burst your teammates.
[위치] Shifting into Bear Form or Travel Form removes movement impairing effects and protects against polymorph effects. Shift out of slows and roots.
bg: [참고] In Battleground Blitz there are 0-1 tanks, and slow tanks need help carrying the flag. Carry with Dash (60% faster for 10 sec) and shapeshift to break movement impairing effects.
[위치] Stampeding Roar increases movement speed of allies within 15 yds by 60% for 8 sec. Use it when the flag carrier and escorts run together or when rotating between bases.
[분담] With Grove Protection, allies inside the grove take 50% less damage from enemies outside it for 10 sec. Drop it on base defense or where you escort the flag carrier.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Prioritize chaining Ironfur armor and Survival Instincts damage reduction over Frenzied Regeneration healing.
[제어] Typhoon and Overrun knock enemies back, but feared or disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Push enemies without CC on them out of the base.
pvpTalents: Den Mother, picked by 20 of the top 25 Solo Shuffle and 38 of 41 Battleground Blitz players, increases max health of allies within 15 yds by 15% and shortens stuns on you. Overrun, picked by 18 of 25 Solo Shuffle and 26 of 41 Battleground Blitz players, stuns the target for 3 sec and knocks back nearby enemies. Demoralizing Roar, picked by 19 of 41 Battleground Blitz players, reduces damage dealt by enemies within 10 yds by 20% for 8 sec.
